title: A coverage indicator drafted as one expression over approved keys
note: AI-AG-006, FR-CMP-010, AI-BR-01: the indicator is a draft expression naming businessKeys, not the compiled programIndicator document.

items.label: report-spec.md
items.content: The district wants a monthly share: doses given divided by doses due, reported per facility, and it should be blank when a facility has no visits at all that month.

expected.summary: Drafted the coverage indicator as one division over the two approved data elements, with a condition that leaves it empty when nothing was due, which is what the report spec's blank rule means. Recorded as a decision because the alternative was defensible.

decisions.subject: rule.indicator.doseCoverage

selected.option: a program indicator with an only-when condition

alternatives.option: a predictor over the two data elements
alternatives.reasonRejected: A predictor writes a value back into the data; the district wants a number that stays recomputed from the visits.

alternatives.option: a legend set over the ratio
alternatives.reasonRejected: That classifies coverage rather than reporting it, and the spec asks for the share.

decisions.rationale: A ratio over collected values, recomputed per period, is an indicator; the blank rule is its only-when condition.

description.default: Doses given as a share of doses due, per facility and month.
